character_reference: a tall, lean man with messy dark hair, wearing a worn charcoal-grey tactical jacket with glowing amber circuitry patterns running down his sleeves
story_so_far: After escaping Commander Vance's server hub and diving into an uncharted underground ocean trench, Kael breached a sunken alien facility. Triggering its dormant systems awakened a menacing automated guardian behind heavy blast doors, forcing him into a desperate fight for survival against powerful new weaponry and strange alien frequencies.
